objective: Replace the shared single-agent OpenClaw development activation with an isolated Sanctuary engineering runtime and explicit supervisor, coding-worker, and reviewer roles.
acceptanceCriteria: The engineering gateway uses unique state, config, port, token, log, and workspace roots and does not write the default OpenClaw state.
Exactly three explicit named roles exist, with delegation on the supervisor, no-prompt coding on one leaf worker, and read-only review.
Channels, browser, hooks, ACP, cron, mDNS, extra plugins, elevated tools, and production credentials remain absent.
The headless 1Password service account and repository-scoped GitHub App work without desktop approval prompts.
The installed Mac OpenClaw build validates the configuration and a secret-free role-boundary rehearsal passes.
stopConditions: The dedicated state directory is already owned by another runtime.
The bundled Codex harness or isolated OpenAI authentication cannot be validated.
A role receives broader authority than this manifest declares.
Validation would require changing or deleting the unrelated default OpenClaw runtime.
